firstPlayerRule: Deal five Scoring Cards to each team. The team whose cards add up to the highest total goes first.
internalEvidence: Fetched the PlayMonster-hosted rules PDF listed on playmonster.com/rules-and-activity-guide/ and extracted its text with pdftotext. PDF page 1: "Shuffle the 10 Scoring Cards and deal them out, five to a team. Each team add up the numbers on your five cards. If your team has the highest total, you go first."
